### 3. ✅ Issue Templates (4 Files)

**Location:** [.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/](../)

**Templates Created:**

#### a) `bug_report.md`
- Structured bug reporting form
- Environment details
- Reproducible steps
- Expected vs actual behavior
- Screenshots section

#### b) `feature_request.md`
- Feature description
- Use case explanation
- Alternatives section
- Checklist for submitters

#### c) `good_first_issue.md`
- Special template for curated beginner tasks
- Mentor assignment
- Step-by-step implementation guide
- Learning objectives
- Testing instructions
- Difficulty level

#### d) `config.yml`
- Disables blank issues
- Directs users to Discussions, Support, Telegram, Twitter

**Impact:** Structured issues lead to better triage and faster resolution

### 5. ✅ Labels & Automation Guide

**Location:** [.github/LABELS_GUIDE.md](../LABELS_GUIDE.md)

**Label System (50+ labels):**

- **Priority:** critical, high, medium, low
- **Type:** bug, enhancement, documentation, refactor, performance, security, testing, i18n, ui/ux, backend
- **Status:** good-first-issue, help-wanted, in-progress, blocked, wontfix, duplicate, needs-review, reviewed, qa-testing, ready-to-merge
- **Area:** browser-core, new-tab, sync, privacy, settings, extensions, devtools, ui, performance, security, build-system, documentation
- **Effort:** small, medium, large, xlarge
- **Special:** epic, milestone, upstream, regression, RFC, chore, dependencies

**Automation Scripts:**
- Auto-label by keywords
- Stale issue automation
- PR review requests
- Auto-assign mentor to good-first-issues

**Impact:** Better issue organization and automated triage

### 7. ✅ Good First Issue Implementation Plan

**Location:** [.github/GOOD_FIRST_ISSUE_PLAN.md](../GOOD_FIRST_ISSUE_PLAN.md)

**5 Phases:**
1. **Setup (Week 1)** — Repository configuration
2. **Identify (Week 2)** — Create 10-15 good-first-issues
3. **Promote (Week 3)** — Social media campaign
4. **Onboard (Ongoing)** — Support new contributors
5. **Scale (Month 2+)** — Grow program

**Success Metrics:**
- 15+ good-first-issues by month 1
- 2-3 new contributors per month initially
- 90%+ PR merge rate
- <24h mentor response time
- 30%+ contributor return rate

**Sample Issues to Create:**
- UI/UX (typos, error messages)
- Documentation (README updates, guides)
- Testing (unit tests, test coverage)
- Refactoring (extract utilities)
- i18n (translations)

## 💡 Best Practices Implemented

✅ **GitHub Documentation Best Practices:**
- Clear, scannable format
- Hierarchy with headers
- Links to related docs
- Visual formatting (tables, lists, emojis)
- Multiple CTAs for different audiences

✅ **Community Building Best Practices:**
- Low barrier to entry (good-first-issues)
- Mentorship program (assigned mentors)
- Clear communication (templates)
- Recognition & rewards
- Feedback loops (discussions)

✅ **SEO Best Practices:**
- Keywords in README header
- Clear title & description
- Structured content
- Badges with alt text
- Internal linking

✅ **Open Source Best Practices:**
- Code of Conduct
- CONTRIBUTING guide
- Clear roadmap
- Security policy
- Issue templates
- Multiple ways to contribute
